instruction.text: Listen and select the correct sentence.

b.sound: Pine is one of the strongest softwoods available.
Pine is one of the strongest bricks available.
Pine trees are an evergreen tree, so they are green all year round.
Pine trees are an evergreen tree, so they lose their needles in autumn.
The seeds of a pine tree are called pine cones.
The seeds of a pine tree are called acorns.

feedback.end: Spruce trees like to grow in cool conditions, like on mountains. They can grow as tall as 60 metres!
Spruce trees also grow their seeds in cones. They are a coniferous tree.

atoms.a: The seeds of spruce trees and pine trees are called cones.
Pine trees lose their needles in the autumn.
